claim.reason: Checks that the battery's responses at the default timestep (0.1 ms) do not depend on the step size more than on the seed. It does not select a timestep, does not change sim.Params and does not replace any frozen score.

decides.converged: a response (case and target) converges at a timestep when its holds verdict (the v4 floor over seeds) equals the reference's and its seed-median target rate differs from the reference's seed median by at most the reference's seed range (max - min over seeds), and never less than the rate quantum (one spike in stim_ms, 3.33 Hz), the resolution of the measurement
decides.verdict: converged if every response converges at 0.1 ms; otherwise not_converged with the list of responses that do not
decides.why_seed_range: numerical error is judged against the variability the model already shows between seeds, floored at the measurement's resolution, so no tolerance is chosen

protocol.evidence_none: A numerical check of the integrator: every parameter is the live default of sim.Params, none is a newly sourced biological value.

grid.dt_rule: halvings of the default; delay (1.8 ms) and t_ref (2.2 ms) stay whole numbers of steps at each

limits: Poisson input is drawn per step, so the input streams differ between timesteps; responses are compared as seed statistics, not spike for spike.
Discrete events (spikes, resets, delayed delivery) act at step boundaries at every timestep; the check measures how much that discretisation moves the responses.
Five seeds give a coarse seed range; a response near the v4 floor can flip its holds verdict with the seeds as well as with the step.

An input event arriving in the step where a stimulated neuron spikes is lost to the reset, and several in one step make one kick: about 1.5% of input events at 0.1 ms against 0.4% at 0.025 ms. This is part of what the check measures.
The best neuron of each target type is picked at each timestep, as validate.respond does, so a left/right switch can compare different neurons.

latency.what: seed-median first spike of the target's best neuron; quantised to the timestep

recruited_persistent.what: seed-median counts of recruited and persistent neurons

protocol.seen_before_lock: The sensitivity grid v1 (results/sensitivity/v1, seeds 0-4) at dt 0.1 ms only. No run at another timestep has been made.
